mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by ≥0.5% over 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.0%, it signals labor market slack triggering central bank rate cuts, producing positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns as policy response is priced in.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0% for ≥2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 60-day returns as economic contraction is anticipated.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline ≥1% over 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In supply contraction regimes (INDPRO < 100), declining industrial production signals manufacturing weakness, producing negative S&P 500 20-day returns as recession risks are priced in.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >40% of instances where INDPRO < 100 for ≥3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDP growth (GDPC1) over the prior 6 months signals expanding economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns as corporate earnings growth is anticipated.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate increases ≥0.5% annually.

mechanism_narrative: When CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 300.0, accelerating inflation triggers central bank rate hikes, producing negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns as discount rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 300.0 for ≥2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in payrolls (PAYEMS) and rises in unemployment (UNRATE) signal labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 20-day returns as recession risks escalate.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances where PAYEMS declines ≥0.5% and UNRATE rises ≥0.2% over 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In housing market collapse regimes (HOUST < 1200.0), declining housing starts signal reduced consumer spending, producing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns as economic weakness is priced in.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of instances where HOUST < 1200.0 for ≥2 consecutive months.
